title: 锥光揭密
summary: 密文不该整段亮出来。指针从固定原点射出锥光，只有落在锥内的字形变成明文，锥外仍是圆点。
summaryEn: A secret should not light up as a whole string. A cone from a fixed origin reveals only the glyphs it covers; the rest stay discs.
asks: 密文该整段揭开，还是只让锥光碰到的字形现身？
asksEn: Should a secret flip as a whole string, or only the glyphs inside a cone?

links.when: 锥光是连续角域覆盖，不是落到图集格子
links.whenEn: a cone is continuous angular coverage, not an atlas cell

links.when: 锥光揭开碰到的字，不是沿字形扫一道高光
links.whenEn: the cone reveals covered glyphs, it is not a traveling sheen

links.when: 空间揭开密文字形不是填写三个时刻该交代什么
links.whenEn: spatial glyph reveal is not what a field discloses across three moments
